name: ob2h
description: Long-term memory, knowledge graph and AST code graph for coding agents: a local MCP server with 57 tools to recall past decisions, save new facts, analyze project architecture and estimate refactor blast radius. Data stays on your machine.

description_i18n.en: Long-term memory, knowledge graph and AST code graph for coding agents: a local MCP server with 57 tools to recall past decisions, save new facts, analyze project architecture and estimate refactor blast radius. Data stays on your machine.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 为编程智能体提供长期记忆、知识图谱与 AST 代码图谱：本地 MCP 服务器，包含 57 个工具，用于回忆过往决策、保存新事实、分析项目架构并评估重构影响范围。数据保存在你的本机。

binary.title: ob2h executable
binary.description: Command or absolute path of the ob2h executable. The default `ob2h` uses the copy on PATH. Set an absolute path if ob2h is installed elsewhere.

data_dir.title: Data directory
data_dir.description: Required. Absolute path of the folder that keeps the memory database, memory files, logs and backups (OB2H_DATA_DIR). Use one folder per user, for example ~/.ob2h. It is created if missing and is not removed when the plugin is uninstalled.
